an5.77:1.1: bhikkhave anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:2.2: Idha bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.77:2.4: ekakaṃ kho pana maṃ araññe viharantaṃ
an5.77:2.5: ahi vā maṃ ḍaseyya, vicchiko vā maṃ ḍaseyya, satapadī vā maṃ ḍaseyya,
an5.77:2.6: tena me assa kālakiriyā, so mam'assa antarāyo.
an5.77:2.7: Handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā' ti.
an5.77:2.8: Idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 3.
an5.77:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.77:3.4: upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā me bhuttaṃ vyāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ,
an5.77:3.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā, so mam' assa antarāyo.
an5.77:3.6: Handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā' ti.
an5.77:3.7: Idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 4.
an5.77:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.77:4.4: vāḷehi samāgaccheyyaṃ sīhena vā vyagghena vā dīpinā vā acchena vā taracchena vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:4.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā, so mam'assa antarāyo.
an5.77:4.6: Handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā' ti.
an5.77:4.7: Idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 5.
an5.77:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.77:5.4: māṇavehi samāgaccheyyaṃ katakammehi vā akatakammehi vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:5.5: tena me assa kālakiriyā, so mam'assa antarāyo.
an5.77:5.6: Handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā' ti.
an5.77:5.7: Idaṃ bhikkhave catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 6.
an5.77:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave āraññako bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.77:6.3: santi kho panāraññe vāḷā amanussā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:6.4: tena me assa kālakiriyā, so mam'assa antarāyo.
an5.77:6.5: Handāhaṃ viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā' ti.
an5.77:6.6: Idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:7.1: Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alam eva āraññakena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā ti. 1.
